title: Exactly one archetype
statement: A declaration MUST select exactly one archetype.

title: No undeclared field
statement: A declaration MUST NOT carry a field that STEGO, the selected archetype or its components do not declare.

title: One document, no indirection
statement: A declaration MUST be one YAML document, and MUST NOT use anchors, aliases or merge keys.

title: Bounded input
statement: A declaration MUST NOT be larger than 4 MiB, and MUST NOT nest more than 128 levels deep.

title: Entity names are unique
statement: Every entity name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: Field names are unique in their entity
statement: Every field name MUST be unique within its entity.

title: Constraints suit the type
statement: A field's constraints MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: Collection names are unique
statement: Every collection name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: A collection reads a declared entity
statement: A collection MUST name an entity that the same declaration declares.

title: A binding names a declared collection and slot
statement: A slot binding MUST name a collection the declaration declares, and a slot that a component of the active component set declares.

title: A bound slot is invoked
statement: A slot binding MUST name a slot that a generator in the build invokes, so a binding cannot compile without ever running.

title: A setting matches its component schema
statement: A component setting MUST name a component of the active component set and a setting that component's schema declares, and its value MUST suit the declared type.

title: A default suits the type
statement: A field's default MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: An experiment is accepted by name
statement: A declaration MUST NOT use a component whose stage is not ga unless it accepts that component by name, with a reason and a date.

title: An acceptance cannot outlive the component
statement: An acceptance date MUST NOT be later than the sunset date of the component it accepts.

title: An acceptance expires
statement: A declaration MUST NOT be accepted after the date of any acceptance it holds.

title: One successor, of the same component
statement: A component digest MUST have at most one successor, and the successor MUST be another digest of the same component.

title: An installation replaces nothing
statement: An installation MUST refuse a result folder that already exists, and MUST NOT change what that folder holds.

title: A failed check leaves no installation
statement: When a digest check or a signature check fails, the installer MUST leave no result folder and no temporary download.

title: A fill implements one slot
statement: A fill MUST name exactly one slot of a component in the active registry, and one collection of the declaration.

title: Evidence names what it was taken against
statement: Test evidence MUST name the fill's content digest and its slot contract's digest as they were when the tests passed.

title: A sign-off signs one evidence
statement: A sign-off MUST carry a signature over the digest of the evidence it signs. When the evidence changes, the old sign-off no longer signs it.

title: A fill carries tests
statement: A fill MUST hold at least one test file. STEGO MUST record no evidence for a fill with none.

title: A fill imports only what it may
statement: A fill's code MUST import only its slot's contract package, the Go standard library and the modules the declaration lists for fills. STEGO MUST record no evidence for a fill that imports anything else.

title: Output and record change as one
statement: The generated files and the record MUST change as one unit. An apply that stops part way MUST leave a journal, and plan, apply and drift MUST refuse to run until recovery completes it.

title: The input manifest agrees with its record
statement: The input manifest in a record MUST name the same declaration digest and registry reference as the record itself, and STEGO MUST refuse a record where they differ.

title: The record names the registry content that produced it
statement: The registry content digest in a record MUST be the digest of the registry content that apply read. Apply MUST refuse a plan that carries another digest, and MUST write nothing.

title: The record names the compiler that produced it
statement: The compiler build in a record MUST be the build identity of the compiler that ran the apply. Apply MUST refuse a plan that carries another, and MUST leave the record unchanged.

title: The record describes the inputs as apply found them
statement: Apply MUST refuse a plan, saved or made in the same run, when a project input, the record or a generated file changed after planning, and MUST write neither files nor the record. So a saved plan applies only to the record it was planned against, and only once.

title: Each planned path has one owner
statement: A plan MUST give each output path to exactly one generator, slot or the assembler. Planning MUST stop on a path that two of them write, and MUST save no plan.

title: A generator writes only inside its namespace
statement: Planning MUST stop when a generator returns a file outside the output namespace its component declares, or when a component that generates files declares no namespace.

title: A plan never touches hand-written code
statement: A plan MUST NOT create, change or delete a file outside the output folder, except the project files that STEGO owns, so a fill and its tests are never written by a run.

title: A failed run writes nothing
statement: When validation, a generator or the assembler fails, STEGO MUST write no generated file, no record and no saved plan.

title: Only qualified fills that fit their binding are wired
statement: Plan and apply MUST stop, and write nothing, when a fill the declaration binds is not qualified or does not fit its binding, as Extending's qualification of each bound fill reports it.

title: A local registry adds and never replaces
statement: A local registry MUST NOT replace a part that the common registry supplies, and MAY only add parts of its own.

title: A component writes only its own namespace
statement: A component MUST write its output only into the namespace it declares, so one component cannot overwrite another's output.

title: An experiment owns only its own port
statement: A component whose stage is not ga MUST NOT provide a port that a ga component provides, so no override can put an experiment on a golden path.

title: A mixin adds and never replaces
statement: A mixin MUST only add components and slots to the archetype it extends, and MUST NOT replace a part of it.

title: Providers of one port agree on every field
statement: Two components that provide the same port MUST put the same meaning in every field of that port, so an override cannot change what a field means.

title: A declared slot is invoked
statement: A generator in the build MUST invoke every slot that its component declares, so a declared extension point cannot be dead.
